title: Pleated Ruffle Tulle V-Neck Maternity Photoshoot Gown
seo_title: Pleated Ruffle V-Neck Maternity Gown | Dress Like Mommy
seo_desc: V-neck maternity photoshoot gown in pleated ruffle tulle with an open front, high slit and sweeping train. 5 colors, US 2 to 26W, made to order.
lead: Made for your maternity photos: a V-neck gown in layer upon layer of pleated ruffled tulle, with ruffled shoulder straps, an open front that frames the bump, and a full tiered skirt with a high slit that sweeps into a long train.
bullets: each gown is sewn after you order and is ready to ship in about 7 days, so please allow about 19-23 days for delivery. Order early for a planned photoshoot.
V-neck with gathered ruffled tulle straps, an open front with a sheer panel over the bump, and a full skirt of cascading pleated ruffle tiers with a high front slit and a long train.
US 2 to US 16 and plus sizes US 18W to US 26W. Compare your bust, waist and hips with the chart below.
Light Blue, Lavender, Soft Yellow, Mint Green and White.
Hand wash cold or dry clean; hang to dry. Steam on low to remove creases.
chart_footnote: Body measurements in cm. Choose by your bust and hips today, and size up if you want extra room over the bump. Hollow to Floor is measured from the base of the neck to the floor, barefoot.
closing: Perfect for maternity photoshoots, gender reveals and baby showers.
garment_lock: a sleeveless maternity gown with a V-neck framed by gathered pleated tulle ruffles that run over the shoulders as straps, an open front with a sheer tulle panel over the bump, and a very full floor-length skirt of cascading tiers of pleated, ruffled tulle with a high front slit and a long sweeping train
